Event Start
	Form.Caption = Format("GXSPC_SelectionList", "Trn Group Probe Base")
	&ADVANCED_LABEL_TEMPLATE = "%1 <strong>%2</strong>"
EndEvent

Event 'Toggle'
	if AdvancedContainer.Class = StyleClass:AdvancedContainer
		AdvancedContainer.Class = StyleClass:AdvancedContainer + !" " + StyleClass:AdvancedContainerVisible
		BtnToggle.Class += !" " + StyleClass:BtnToggleActive
	else
		AdvancedContainer.Class = StyleClass:AdvancedContainer
		BtnToggle.Class = StyleClass:BtnToggle
	endif
Endevent

Event LblTrnGroupProbeBaseIdFilter.Click
	if TrnGroupProbeBaseIdFilterContainer.Class = StyleClass:AdvancedContainerItem
		TrnGroupProbeBaseIdFilterContainer.Class = StyleClass:AdvancedContainerItem + !" " + StyleClass:AdvancedContainerItemExpanded
		&cTrnGroupProbeBaseId.Visible = true
	else
		TrnGroupProbeBaseIdFilterContainer.Class = StyleClass:AdvancedContainerItem
		&cTrnGroupProbeBaseId.Visible = false
	endif
EndEvent

Event LblGpBaseIdFilter.Click
	if GpBaseIdFilterContainer.Class = StyleClass:AdvancedContainerItem
		GpBaseIdFilterContainer.Class = StyleClass:AdvancedContainerItem + !" " + StyleClass:AdvancedContainerItemExpanded
		&cGpBaseId.Visible = true
	else
		GpBaseIdFilterContainer.Class = StyleClass:AdvancedContainerItem
		&cGpBaseId.Visible = false
	endif
EndEvent

Event LblGpBaseDescFilter.Click
	if GpBaseDescFilterContainer.Class = StyleClass:AdvancedContainerItem
		GpBaseDescFilterContainer.Class = StyleClass:AdvancedContainerItem + !" " + StyleClass:AdvancedContainerItemExpanded
		&cGpBaseDesc.Visible = true
	else
		GpBaseDescFilterContainer.Class = StyleClass:AdvancedContainerItem
		&cGpBaseDesc.Visible = false
	endif
EndEvent

Event Load
	&LinkSelection.FromImage(selectRow)
EndEvent

Event Enter
	&pTrnGroupProbeBaseId = TrnGroupProbeBaseId
	Return
EndEvent
